meta.name: skill-builder
meta.description: Automatically detect source types and build AI skills using Skill Seekers. Use when the user wants to create skills from documentation, repos, PDFs, videos, or other knowledge sources.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从文档、代码库等来源自动构建AI技能
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要从各种资料中创建AI技能
copy.tagline_en: Automatically build AI skills from docs, repos, and more
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to create AI skills from various sources

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能自动识别文档、GitHub 仓库、PDF、视频等来源类型，并用对应工具抓取内容，生成可供 AI 使用的技能包。
howto.when: 当你提供文档链接、GitHub 仓库地址、PDF 文件、视频链接或本地代码路径，并希望将其转化为 AI 技能时触发。

say.text: 帮我从 https://example.com/docs 创建一个技能。
say.note: Claude 会检测来源类型并开始抓取。

say.text: 把 owner/repo 这个 GitHub 仓库做成 AI 技能。
say.note: Claude 会使用 GitHub 抓取工具。

say.text: 将这个 PDF 文件转换为技能包。
say.note: Claude 会使用 PDF 抓取工具。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can automatically detect source types such as documentation, GitHub repos, PDFs, videos, and local code, then use the appropriate tools to scrape content and generate AI-ready skill packages.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you provide a documentation URL, GitHub repo, PDF file, video link, or local code path and want to convert it into an AI skill.

say_en.note: Claude will detect the source type and start scraping.

say_en.text: Turn the GitHub repo owner/repo into an AI skill.
say_en.note: Claude will use the GitHub scraping tool.

say_en.text: Convert this PDF file into a skill package.
say_en.note: Claude will use the PDF scraping tool.
